description: Aggregated run view: run info + (optional) metric history + (optional) artifacts list in a single call. Replaces 3-4 round-trips of get-run + get-metric-history (per metric) + list-artifacts.

artifactPath.description: Optional sub-path within artifacts to list

extractFields.description: Comma-separated dotted paths to project from response. Use `*` as wildcard.

includeMetricHistory.description: Include time-series metric history (default false — set true for plot-ready data)

metricKeys.description: Specific metric keys to fetch history for (default: all metrics on the run)

name: summarize-run
